scope: Isolated pgx driver reproduction against the running PostgreSQL; not an OpenFGA deployment or proof attributing every historical 503.
method: Upstream slowConn reproduction, delaying writes by 60ms and cancelling first query at 95ms, then SELECT 2 on the same connection. Final test adds SELECT pg_sleep(1) with 20ms deadline. Three independent connections per series; no application execution or automatic retries.
